name: Beaked cornsalad
desc: Beaked cornsalad (Valerianella radiata): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 7 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Valeriana woodsiana, common name beaked cornsalad, is a plant native to the United States. It is an annual self pollinating flowering plant and besides being edible there are no known uses.
